MATHEMATICS ACTIVITIES — TERMLY EXAM #20
====

GRADE: Grade 1
SUBJECT: MATHEMATICS ACTIVITIES
TIME ALLOWED: 1 hour 30 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 50
EXAM BODY: KPSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Solve for x: x + 4 = 15. (1 mark)
   A. 4
   B. 12
   C. 15
   D. 11

2. In the number 3547, what is the place value of digit 4? (1 mark)
   A. 4
   B. 10
   C. 400
   D. 40

3. What is 8 × 5? (1 mark)
   A. 3
   B. 13
   C. 40
   D. 41

4. A square plot has side 6 m. What is its area in m²? (1 mark)
   A. 12
   B. 36
   C. 24
   D. 42

5. A square plot has side 12 m. What is its area in m²? (1 mark)
   A. 24
   B. 48
   C. 156
   D. 144

6. A square plot has side 9 m. What is its area in m²? (1 mark)
   A. 18
   B. 36
   C. 81
   D. 90

7. What is the square of 9? (1 mark)
   A. 82
   B. 18
   C. 81
   D. 9

8. What is the square of 13? (1 mark)
   A. 170
   B. 169
   C. 26
   D. 13

9. What is 8 × 8? (1 mark)
   A. 0
   B. 16
   C. 65
   D. 64

10. In a right-angled triangle, the two shorter sides are 5 cm and 12 cm. Find the hypotenuse. (1 mark)
   A. 17
   B. 7
   C. 13
   D. 15

11. What is 4 × 4? (1 mark)
   A. 17
   B. 0
   C. 16
   D. 8

12. In the number 3147, what is the place value of digit 4? (1 mark)
   A. 4
   B. 40
   C. 10
   D. 400

13. What is the square of 7? (1 mark)
   A. 7
   B. 50
   C. 49
   D. 14

14. What is 4 × 6? (1 mark)
   A. 25
   B. 24
   C. 10
   D. 2

15. What is 8 × 3? (1 mark)
   A. 5
   B. 25
   C. 11
   D. 24

16. Volume of a cube of side 3 cm is: (1 mark)
   A. 27 cm³
   B. 18 cm³
   C. 12 cm³
   D. 9 cm³

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
